title: Per-Invocation ingestion-health completeness
method: the Recorder writes a durable INVOCATION_INGESTION_INCOMPLETE marker when a valid report cannot be recorded; the window validator refuses it as a closure; the health read is durable so a different Recorder instance sees the same state
observed: health states COMPLETE_SO_FAR / INGESTION_FAILED; failure is sticky, keyed per ${attemptId}::${invocationId}, and NOT cleared by a later success or an idempotent duplicate
expectedInvariant: every valid Session Identity report received before the accepted close boundary is either durably represented or leaves a durable completeness uncertainty that prevents final qualification
remainingUncertainty: the marker records the REASON and a bounded detail, never the lost SessionId (which is unknown to durable evidence and must not be fabricated)
